description: Replace one item's volume price tiers (by id or SKU) with the list given: each tier is a minimum order quantity (greater than zero, unique) and the unit price from that quantity up. Tiers not in the list are removed; an empty list removes them all. The preview shows the tiers before→after with % off list and warns when a tier is not below the list price. A client-pinned credential prices only its own items. Requires the Admin role in the app.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

tiers.description: The complete tier list (max 50); an empty list removes every tier.

minimumQuantity.description: Minimum order quantity for this tier (greater than zero, unique per item).

price.description: Unit price at this tier (0 or more).

name: set_item_volume_pricing
title: Set Item Volume Pricing
